 IMD Weather Today, November 11, 2026: Heavy Rain Alert in Andaman and Tamil Nadu, Check State-Wise Forecast
 By Jasreet Kaur Last Updated: Nov 11, 2026, 13:00 IST IMD has forecast heavy rainfall in parts of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Tamil Nadu and other regions on November 11, 2026. Check state-wise weather updates and the forecast for the coming days.
 IMD Weather Today, November 11, 2026: Heavy Rain Alert in Andaman and Tamil Nadu, Check State-Wise Forecast 
 The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast rain and changing weather conditions in several parts of the country on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal are among the regions likely to receive heavy rainfall at isolated places. A western disturbance is also expected to affect the western Himalayan region, bringing rain and snowfall to Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh over the coming days. Meanwhile, Delhi, Haryana and Chandigarh are likely to remain dry until November 17. Here is the state-wise weather forecast for November 11 and the coming days.
 Which States Will Receive Rain Today?
 The IMD forecast indicates rainfall in parts of southern, eastern and northeastern India, along with the western Himalayan region.
 State or Region Weather Forecast

 Delhi, Haryana and Chandigarh Dry weather expected 
 Heavy Rain Alert in Tamil Nadu and Andaman
 The IMD has forecast heavy rainfall at isolated places over the Andaman and Nicobar Islands from November 11 to 14. Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal may also receive heavy rainfall on November 11. Another spell is forecast on November 15 and 16. The department has also indicated the possibility of heavy rain in parts of Tamil Nadu and Kerala on November 17.
 Western Disturbance to Bring Rain and Snowfall
 A western disturbance is currently positioned over north Pakistan and adjoining areas. The weather system is expected to affect the western Himalayan region.
